script.na_text: This browser offers no SHA-256 on this page. Open the site over https, or run validate_core.py.
script.notobj_text: The text is not a JSON object, so there is no canonical form to digest. A validator stops here.
script.tamper_text: The meaning changed. The semantic digest no longer equals the one the attestation names, so the attestation does not cover this object.
script.semantic_text: The bytes changed, the meaning did not. The attestation still covers the object; the verifier reports that the packaging was altered.
script.full_text: Bytes and meaning are the ones recorded in the example bundle's content manifest.
script.all_hold: every criterion holds on the observation
script.engine_failed_text: The verdict is computed by the app's rules, which this copy of the site does not include. Open the Checks page of the app instead.
script.engine_loading_text: The page fetches the app's kernel rules once.
script.verdict_satisfied: Both checks hold. The Assessment records each observation, so a second party reaches this verdict without running anything.
script.verdict_not_satisfied: One definite failure decides the aggregate. The failing row names the clause, and a Finding against that clause can point back to the check.
script.verdict_other: No observation, no verdict: a default is never substituted. The row is recorded as inconclusive and must carry a reason.
